# Canonical VST3 ABI runtime

This directory contains the runtime binding surface generated by the pinned
upstream generator from the verified complete official Steinberg VST3 3.8.1
interface tree, plus the original `vst3-rs` Rust COM support runtime. The host,
workspace ABI oracle and owned reference fixtures consume
this exact package. `com-scrape-types` is the single local support package.

`PROVENANCE.json` pins every source identity and shipped file hash. The original
MIT/Apache-2.0 upstream license files and the official Steinberg MIT license are
retained separately. No handwritten ABI extension, old binding shim or second
COM runtime is included. SDK interface availability does not imply the product
implements every optional host capability.

Generation uses the original upstream generator, with sorted header enumeration,
against the complete verified official interface tree. Compiler/environment and
actual generated binding receipts are recorded in the provenance manifest.
Cross-platform size/alignment/offset/GUID C++ oracle tests remain required.
The original generator excludes SDK testing interfaces and selected C++ helper
headers/types; `PROVENANCE.json` records that policy. These bindings are not an
export of every declaration in the source tree.

To prepare a fresh verified generator tree, use:
`python scripts/validation/regenerate-vst3-sdk.py --output <fresh-directory>`.
To explicitly generate on the qualified generation target, add
`--run-generator --target x86_64-pc-windows-gnu --libclang <LLVM-bin>
--cxx-include-bin <MinGW-bin>`. The tool verifies each immutable Git blob and
SHA256, downloads no forked SDK, and uses a separate Cargo home/target and the
independent recorded generator lock. It never edits the shipped runtime.
Windows GNU generation is recorded; native MSVC and macOS ABI oracles remain
required. SDK layouts/GUIDs and signatures do not qualify plugin behavior.

The package defines a runtime-only workspace with `com-scrape-types`. This
explicit boundary keeps standalone Cargo metadata and formatting independent
of the application workspace and enclosing development checkouts.
